column1:
1. MY TARGET MARKET
- Primary: Local women (28-45) in Chacarita/Palermo/Colegiales (tech/design/office).
- Secondary: English-speaking expats & digital nomads.
- Tertiary: Craft fair shoppers.
column2:
2. MY MESSAGE
- "Slow down and create with your hands."
- An off-screen, calm escape in a cozy studio.
- English-friendly classes available.
- For mugs: Unique stoneware, handmade in BA.
column3:
3. THE MEDIA
- Instagram (@taller.lento): Wheel-throwing Reels.
- Weekend Palermo craft fair.
- Google Maps (New action: Create profile).
- WhatsApp (Direct communication).

column1:
4. MY LEAD CAPTURE SYSTEM
- Fair Clipboard/QR code: "Classes Waitlist" (capture WhatsApp number).
- Instagram: Update Linktree to a direct WhatsApp link saying "Book a class / Join the waitlist".
column2:
5. MY LEAD NURTURING SYSTEM
- WhatsApp Broadcasts: Send alerts to the waitlist when a Taster Class or monthly spot opens up.
- IG Stories: Show the studio atmosphere and student progress.
column3:
6. MY SALES CONVERSION STRATEGY
- Post-Taster Follow-up: Message Taster students 2 days later offering a spot in the monthly class.
- Taster Offer: "Sign up for the monthly class today and get a free mug."

column1:
7. WORLD-CLASS EXPERIENCE
- Small, intimate classes (max 6 students).
- High-quality materials and signature glazes.
- Bilingual instruction (Spanish/English).
- A relaxing, welcoming environment.
column2:
8. INCREASE CUSTOMER LTV
- Month 2 Project Goal: Give students a reason to stay past month 1.
- Week 3 Check-ins: Secure next month's booking before schedules change.
- Fill the Wednesday group via waitlisters.
column3:
9. ORCHESTRATE REFERRALS
- "Bring a Friend" Perk: Current students get a free bag of clay if they bring a friend to a class.
- IG Sharing: Create a photo spot and encourage students to tag @taller.lento.
